title: acer trifidum f. ningpoense
intro: Acer trifidum f. ningpoense, commonly known as the Chinese Maple, is a variety of maple tree native to China. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to protect against cell damage and reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of Acer trifidum f. ningpoense include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects, making it useful for treating pain, inflammation, and muscle spasms. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
